Add SharePoint List Item.description: Adds a new item (row) to a SharePoint list, e.g. a beneficiary register.

Send Email.description: Sends an email from a mailbox, e.g. a weekly stock-out alert to programme staff.

Post Message to Teams Channel.description: Posts a message to a Microsoft Teams channel, e.g. to notify a team of a new case.

Create Calendar Event.description: Creates a calendar event for a user, e.g. a follow-up visit or training session.

Upload File to SharePoint.description: Uploads a file (e.g. a generated Excel report) into a SharePoint or OneDrive folder.

List SharePoint List Items.description: Fetches the items of a SharePoint list, including their column values.

Download File From SharePoint.description: Downloads the contents of a file (e.g. a CSV export) from a SharePoint document library.

List Files in Folder.description: Lists the files in a SharePoint or OneDrive folder, e.g. to find new uploads to process.

List Users.description: Lists users in the organisation's directory, e.g. to sync staff accounts.

List Recent Emails.description: Fetches recent emails from a mailbox, e.g. a shared intake inbox.
